horn.repo.description: Absolute path to the HORN repository checkout containing canonical .horn.json documents, the TypeScript presentation adapter, and the native libhorn build.

horn.npm.description: npm executable used for presentation-only Zeppelin projections such as render, network, audit, and manifest.

horn.celix.description: Path to the pinned libhorn Celix driver. Relative paths are resolved from horn.repo. Used by runtime, validate, and inspect.

horn.command.timeout.millis.description: Maximum execution time for one HORN presentation or Celix-backed analysis command.
